data.narrative:
Manna Aero is a Series B autonomous drone company founded by Bobby Healy that has raised $110M to date. The relevant peer universe consists of 8 private companies in the Drones & Autonomous sector, including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation. No public comparables exist in this subsector.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of $110M as a baseline and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement yields an implied valuation of $209M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints—while 5 same-sector peers were identified, only 1 possessed matching stage characteristics, falling short of the 3-point minimum threshold for reliable multiples-based triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $178M (low) to $240M (high), with a median point of $209M. Key uncertainties center on the thinness of stage-specific comparables in this subsector and the absence of public market benchmarks to validate private valuations. The range reflects ±15% variance around the median to account for execution risk and the early-stage nature of autonomous vehicle commercialization. Valuation confidence would materially improve with additional late-stage private raises or near-term public listings among peer companies.
